name: Giant Origami Crane Over Bamboo
description: A massive origami crane, its wings made of translucent paper, soaring above a misty bamboo forest, leaving trails of glowing ink in its wake.
prompt: Huge origami crane with paper wings shimmering, soaring above a bamboo forest shrouded in mist, trails of luminous ink drifting behind, soft sunrise light, ultra‑realistic, dreamy composition, no text, sense of motion and grace.
caption: Watch the giant paper crane glide through the bamboo—its wing strokes leave trails of liquid starlight.
